approvalBasis: User directed the refinement: all overlap in the centre, fewer buttons, Apple design philosophy. Built from this explicit instruction; no additional approval round requested.
prompt: Revise this Daily Arcade iOS app mockup according to the user's precise design feedback. Preserve the deep midnight blue, sapphire and subtle icy edge sheen, serif brand title and native iOS styling. CRITICAL STRUCTURE CHANGE: all SIX game cards overlap in ONE compact centered deck in the middle of the screen. No separate next card below. Cards behind are visible as gently fanned edges, rotated between -4 and +4 degrees, with slight offsets, all belonging to the same centered stack. The front card is about 335pt wide and 435pt tall centered at mid-screen, the rest peek behind at top and side edges, visibly a deck to swipe through. Remove ALL separate Play buttons, no action buttons anywhere in the front card. The entire front card is the tap target. Remove big number 7 as a marketing centerpiece. Front card title 'Deep Cut' in refined white serif, one modest row of seven small round markers, then a beautiful spare trivia composition with three typographic answers in delicate rows 'The obvious answer' / 'The clever answer' / 'Your answer', with tiny score figures '10' / '50' / '?' aligned right, meant as a conceptual example rather than a live question. Lower third of card has a small SF-symbol waveform, 'Rare answers. Good instincts.' and small '7 rounds · 25 sec each'. Restrained subtle blue specular edge, no giant glow and no shiny pill control. Top screen is native iOS large-title header 'Daily Arcade' with 'Monday, November 2' and '0 of 6 played' below. Short unobtrusive instruction below central deck 'Swipe to explore · Tap to play' with a tiny swipe gesture symbol. Bottom standard native three-tab iOS tab bar Today, Archive, You. Plenty of calm navy negative space between header, centered stack and tab bar. Follow Apple's design philosophy: clarity, deference, depth, direct manipulation, minimal chrome. There must not be a stacked page scroll or a detached second card at bottom; all cards remain in the same central stack. Portrait fullbleed 402x874 equivalent iPhone screenshot without frame. No extra decorative buttons, no neon, no logos from other companies.
status: Superseded by the user-approved X open-fold design.
